source.title: EMSD, District Cooling Services Charges (rates under the District Cooling Services Ordinance, Cap. 624)
source.notes: Capacity charge = contract capacity x capacity rate (per month). Consumption charge = metered cooling energy x consumption rate. Capacity rate adjusts with the Composite CPI; consumption rate adjusts with the electricity tariff. A capacity overrun is charged at 1.1 x the capacity rate on the excess (LegCo Panel on Environmental Affairs paper, 17 July 2014); this tool assumes no overrun.
